'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Andrew Bollentino DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Bollentino]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Andrew Bolletino
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
